question: Why was Hacienda Luisita, Inc. created shortly after the agrarian reform law was passed?
answer: TADECO created it in August 1988 to implement the Stock Distribution Option at Hacienda Luisita.
reference_answer: TADECO created it in August 1988 to implement the Stock Distribution Option at Hacienda Luisita.

question: What does the manual mean by 'bungkalan'?
answer: It is the organized occupation and cultivation of land controlled by landlords or large companies, primarily to produce food while asserting farmers' land rights.
reference_answer: It is the organized occupation and cultivation of land controlled by landlords or large companies, primarily to produce food while asserting farmers' land rights.
supporting_quote_id: Ang bungkalan  ay tumutugon  sa bahagi ng  kabuhayan ng mga magbubukid habang isinusulong nila ang masalimuot na pakikibaka para sa karapatan sa lupa. Kilusang masa ang nagtataguyod sa sama-samang bungkalan at pagpapaunlad sa produksiyon.  Ang mga ito ay integral na bahagi ng tuloy-tuloy na pagsusulong ng pakikibaka para sa pambansang demokrasya --  para  sa  tunay  na  reporma  sa  lupa,  hustisyang  panlipunan,    at  pambansang    industriyalisasyon.    Ang bungkalan  ay isang militanteng paraan ng paggigiit sa karapatan sa lupa ayon sa prinsipyo ng 'lupa para sa nagbubungkal.'

question: Besides technical knowledge, what conditions does the manual say are needed for organic farming to expand?

reference_answer: Strong farmer organization and collective action, control over land, seed and irrigation, preservation of traditional varieties, and suitable machinery, irrigation, and alternative energy are needed.

question: What physical, chemical, and biological improvements does organic fertilizer bring to soil?
answer: It darkens and loosens the soil, improves aeration, rooting and water movement; increases immediately available minerals; and multiplies organisms that drive decomposition, nutrient formation, and biological nitrogen fixation.
reference_answer: It darkens and loosens the soil, improves aeration, rooting and water movement; increases immediately available minerals; and multiplies organisms that drive decomposition, nutrient formation, and biological nitrogen fixation.
supporting_quote_id:
· Pagpaparami ng iba't ibang organismo na nabubuhay sa lupa gaya ng uod, nematodes, protozoa, mikrobyo o bakterya na tumutulong sa pagpapataba ng lupa at pagpapayabong ng mga halaman. Ang mga mikrobyo ay may mahalagang papel sa paggawa ng sustansiya sa lupa gaya ng ammonification, denitrification, at biyolohikal na paghahanda ng nitrohino (biological nitrogen fixation).
## Komposting

Kung isasapraktika ang organiko at likas-kayang pagsasaka sa konteksto ng kampanyang bungkalan, dapat tiyakin na ang mga magsasaka ay magkakaroon ng tuloytuloy na mapagkukunan ng organikong abono. Kung hindi, napakadali para sa mga magsasaka na muling bumaling sa agrokemikal na pagsasaka dahil ito pa rin ang laganap na kalakaran sa kanayunan.

## Pagpapalit-palit ng pananim (Crop Rotation)

Ang  pagpapalit-palit  ng  mga  tanim o  crop  rotation  sa iisang lugar ay ginagawa upang mapanatiling mataba ang lupa dulot ng mga pananim na mayaman sa sustansiyang kailangan nito.  Nagdudulot ang ganitong proseso ng iba't ibang sustansiya sa lupa o nutrient cycling.

question: What flooding, drying, and weeding cycle is recommended after SRI seedlings are transplanted?
answer: Irrigate after 7 to 10 days, flood for 2 to 3 days, then dry for 5 to 7 days and repeat. Weed after 7 to 10 days and again every 7 to 10 days, ideally three or four times before the leaves close.
reference_answer: Irrigate after 7 to 10 days, flood for 2 to 3 days, then dry for 5 to 7 days and repeat. Weed after 7 to 10 days and again every 7 to 10 days, ideally three or four times before the leaves close.
